capabilities: Assign a tag to a folder from the file explorer context menu
Automatically tag notes created in or moved into auto-tag folders
Stack nested folder tags and follow folder renames and moves
Prompt before removing tags when notes leave a folder
Re-apply a folder's tag to all existing notes
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later; beta builds installable via BRAT; all processing runs locally. Limitations include possible removal of manually added tags, missed changes while Obsidian is closed, and Markdown-only tagging.
problem: Obsidian requires tagging each note by hand, so notes in a folder don't automatically share that folder's tag.

relations.evidence: Works with templates: tags survive a template rewriting a new note

summary: Folder-based auto-tagger that assigns a chosen tag to notes created in or moved into configured folders via the tags property.
